name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2015 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2015 record supports: the techniques ATT&CK lists for the objects it ties to 2015 reports and events (campaign C0028, the 2015 Ukraine Electric Power Attack; G0020 Equation; G0016 APT29 and S0037 HAMMERTOSS; G0007 APT28 and S0044 JHUHUGIT for CVE-2015-1701; S0038 Duqu for Duqu 2.0; S0047 Hacking Team UEFI Rootkit; S0519 SYNful Knock; S0030 Carbanak; S0384 Dridex; S0607 KillDisk; G0027 Threat Group-3390) and the procedure rows on the T1203 and T1068 pages that name 2015 CVEs, and behavior described by the primary records the study cites: US-CERT's alerts on Cisco ROMMON images, web shells and the IC3's CryptoWall and DDoS extortion notices, ICS-CERT's alert on the Ukrainian blackout, Oracle's WebLogic alert, the ICO's TalkTalk account, Unit 42's XcodeGhost report, the GRIZZLY STEPPE report, GitHub's and Citizen Lab's accounts of the Great Cannon and Kaspersky's Carbanak release; the Juniper ScreenOS, FREAK and Logjam rows are Inferred. No 2015 source prints an ATT&CK id: ATT&CK was released publicly in May 2015 and no 2015 event was mapped to it at the time. The 20 ATT&CK for ICS techniques of C0028 are in the separate layer navigator/case-studies/chronicle-2015-ics.json. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2015.md. Scores: 100 an ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
